acceptance.title: Hlola imigomo yethu ungakaqhubeki
acceptance.body: Ukuze usebenzise i-Race Tracker, ngicela ubale njalo uvume Imigomo Lemibandela yethu, wazi lenqubomgomo Yobumfihlo yethu.
acceptance.updatedBody: Sivuselele Imigomo Lemibandela kumbe Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo. Ngicela uhlole inguqulo yakhathesi ukuze uqhubeke.
acceptance.checkbox: Ngibalile njalo ngiyavumelana leMigomo LeMibandela, njalo ngiyayazi Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo.
acceptance.failed: Asikwazanga ukubhala ukuvuma kwakho. Ngicela uzame njalo.
acceptance.outdated: Amabhuku la avuselelwe ngemva kokuthi i-app ilayishe. Layisha ikhasi kabutsha, uhlole inguqulo yakhathesi, ubusuzama njalo.
